summary: Comprehensive testing of BRUNO Tienda PIUP (Store) features. All backend APIs pass (16/16 tests). Frontend store page loads correctly with products, category filtering via BubbleSelect works, cart functionality (add/remove/quantity) works, checkout modal with address form displays correctly. Spring animations (iOS 26 style) verified with cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) curves.
critical_code_review_comments: Spring animations correctly use iOS 26 style cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for bounce effect
BubbleSelect component properly implements glassmorphism with backdrop-filter: blur(20px/30px)
Store products are seeded automatically if not present in database
Cart sidebar uses spring-modal animation class for smooth entrance
Checkout flow redirects to Stripe (MOCKED - cannot complete real payment in test)
seed_data_creation: Store products auto-seeded by backend when collection is empty
context_for_next_testing_agent: Store (PIUP) fully tested. All product categories present (nfc_card, nfc_bracelet, nfc_pet_tag, service). Subscription plans (free, pro, business) verified. Cart and checkout flow work correctly. Stripe checkout is connected but payment completion is MOCKED.

store_page_loads.details: Tienda PIUP page loads at /store with 11 products displayed

category_filter_bubbleselect.details: BubbleSelect dropdown shows 5 categories: Todos, Tarjetas NFC, Pulseras Guardian, Tags Mascotas, Servicios

add_to_cart.details: Products can be added to cart, cart count badge updates with spring-bounce animation

cart_sidebar.details: Cart sidebar opens with spring-modal animation, shows items, quantity controls, subtotal, shipping, total

checkout_modal.details: Checkout modal shows shipping address form with all required fields

store_icon_in_feed.details: ShoppingBag icon visible in Feed page header, links to /store

api_store_products.details: GET /api/store/products returns products with correct structure

api_plans.details: GET /api/plans returns 3 plans (free, pro, business) with features and limits

api_user_saved_data.details: GET /api/user/saved-data returns user's saved addresses, social links, etc. (requires auth)

spring_animations_css.details: Spring animations use cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for iOS 26 style bounce effect

bubbleselect_mobile.details: BubbleSelect works on mobile viewport (390x844), opens/closes correctly

mocked_integrations.stripe_checkout: Stripe checkout is connected but payment completion cannot be tested (redirects to real Stripe)
